messages:
alice (Support): FYI — customer 'orbit-labs' reported their free-trial balance dropped to 0 overnight. They insist they didn't run any bulk jobs. Investigating logs now.

michael (CS): Thanks — can you paste the time window and org id? I'll flag they should expect a rapid response.

alice (Support): Window 03:10–03:40 UTC. Org: orbit-labs (org_0x9f). Initial log lines show a massive fanout to /v1/embeddings from our nightly vec-sync. Lots of 5xx then client-side retries. Example snippet:```
[2026-02-12T03:12:05Z] POST /v1/embeddings 500 internal
[2026-02-12T03:12:06Z] worker: retrying chunk id=chunk_448 attempt=1
[2026-02-12T03:12:07Z] POST /v1/embeddings 500
[2026-02-12T03:12:07Z] worker: retrying chunk id=chunk_448 attempt=2
[2026-02-12T03:12:08Z] POST /v1/embeddings 401 unauthorized (token refresh)
```

chris (Infra): We rotated the svc-to-svc token at 02:50 UTC as part of an automated rotation. If the vec-sync job caches the token and doesn't reload it, a 401 could trigger the client to requeue/retry. If the job retries aggressively (synchronous retry per item) that could multiply calls.

deb (ML Eng): Also from code review: the nightly job only marks items processed after callback success. On transient errors the job re-enqueues without an idempotency key. So one failed callback -> requeue -> same items re-fanout. Combine that with 3 immediate retries per chunk and you get 3x-4x token usage.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: rollout/redwood-vec-sync v3.14.1 -> prod at 02:58 UTC by infra/rotations.

chris (Infra): Repro in staging: ran vec-sync with a deliberately invalid token and saw the worker send 3 POSTs per chunk in <2s, then requeue the chunk, resulting in ~4x requests per logical item. For our typical chunk size (128 ids) that’s thousands of embedding calls per job.

alice (Support): Immediate mitigation applied: disabled nightly vec-sync for orbit-labs at 03:25 UTC, issued provisional credit restore (20k units) to the account, and informed customer. Opening a support case ticket with the CS team.

michael (CS): Customer accepted provisional credits and is okay with the pause. Next steps: (1) change retry policy for embeddings in vec-sync to exponential backoff + jitter and max 2 retries, (2) add idempotency key to chunk processing to prevent re-fanout, (3) ensure token cache invalidation on rotation, (4) create alert when a single org consumes >5000 trial units/hr.

deb (ML Eng): I'll draft an RFC for chunk-level idempotency and adjust the callback semantics so processed flag flips before external call or we write an at-most-once marker. Also will propose a default retry cap for background embedding callers.

chris (Infra): I'll add token-cache invalidation to the rotation workflow and a quick audit of other background jobs that might be affected. Also suggest a short-term config change to lower chunk size for all trial accounts.

alice (Support): Thanks all. I'll keep the case updated. cc @michael (CS) — please confirm when credits finalised and when we can re-enable the job. :thumbsup:

michael (CS): Will confirm after RFC/infra mitigations. Great catch. :white_check_mark:
